usage: deskops atoms merge [-h] --into TARGET_ATOM_ID [--root ROOT] [--force]
                           doc_id

positional arguments:
  doc_id                Source atom selector. Selectors accept an exact id,
                        filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where
                        supported.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --into TARGET_ATOM_ID
                        Existing target atom selector that absorbs the source
                        atom.
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --force               Proceed when merge semantics are ambiguous, such as
                        conflicting five_wh_one_plus values. Inbound
                        atom:<source> references are rewritten to
                        atom:<target>, and the source atom is kept as a
                        redirect stub for traceability.
